## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Storage migration is a one-time operation. No action needed; the contract is already up to date.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
f.client.mock_all_auths().set_frozen(&f.governor, &true);
f.client.mock_all_auths().migrate_storage(&f.governor, &0, &50);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_migrate_storage(&f.governor, &0, &50));
```
